free_tier.stated: Free mode still exists and its limits are now unpublished. The docs say 'Free mode lets you create API keys and use included monthly usage within the limits shown on the Limits page', and the help centre names the three limit dimensions, 'Requests per second (RPS)', 'Tokens per minute' and 'Tokens per month'. No figure appears on any public Mistral page: the docs point at admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits, which is behind a login. The Free card of mistral.ai/pricing carried 'Test Mistral models in Studio' and '$10 /mo in API credits' in archive captures of 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-05; the live page on 2026-10-31 carries neither line, so the USD 10 monthly credit that third parties still quote is withdrawn.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: an unpublished monthly cap is still a cap: the only safe composition is to treat the free key as a prototype lane and move any recurring job to Cloudflare's published 10,000 Neurons a day, which at least prints its meter.

limits.value: the number that binds is not published, so the honest answer is that the monthly token cap is unknown until an account exists; third-party guides that still print '1 billion tokens a month' and '1 request a second' describe the retired Experiment plan, whose help pages now return 404.

notes: Refutation of widely repeated figures: the monthly token and per-second request figures that third-party guides print for Mistral's free API tier are attributed to the Experiment plan, whose help article is no longer served, and no current Mistral docs, help or pricing page prints a Free mode figure; the docs defer to the Limits page behind sign-in. The monthly API credit line of the Free card on mistral.ai/pricing, present in archive captures of 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-05, is absent from the live page on 2026-10-31. Identity: the Experiment plan help article, as archived on 2026-05-18, required a verified phone number, one per plan, and no credit card; the current registration form asks for an email and a password, with no phone field. Free mode inputs and outputs may be used for model training unless the Anonymous improvement data toggle under Privacy in the Admin panel is disabled.
